sharing.definition: block_sharing_rate = leading block-aligned prefix blocks already present in an earlier request / total block-aligned prompt blocks. This is the infinite-cache ORACLE hit rate and an upper bound on any measured one.

server_usage.note: server sent no usage in the stream (ours ignores stream_options)

notes: CLOSED LOOP: N workers, each sends its next request when the previous one finishes, so exactly N are in flight. Latency is timed from the moment the worker became free; coordinated omission does not apply because there is no schedule to fall behind, and no queue deeper than N can form by construction. This mode cannot locate a saturation knee (that is W2's job).
